alex: Quick shout  Heads-up: quiet-freeze tomorrow 2026-03-25 07:00-11:00 UTC. This is a short dependency sweep + one hotpatch. Pls skim and flag blockers.

alex: TL;DR:
- Freeze window: 07:00-11:00 UTC (no non-critical deploys).
- Target: roll hotpatch to model-proxy to address 503 spike under sharded loads.
- Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~90m with health gates.
- If youre on-call, monitor 99p latency and 5xx rate for model-proxy and router.

fern: Which repo contains the hotpatch? Are we also changing config maps?
alex: patch is in infra/model-proxy: `hotfix/20260325-backpressure`. Only change is tweak to connection pool backpressure and 2s retry jitter. No configmap edits.

ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window created: 2026-03-25T07:00:00Z - 2026-03-25T11:00:00Z — id: mw-20260325-0710

lia: Ill prep a smoke test harness for embeddings and long-seq generation. Can someone add a quick perf test to the canary job?

fern: I can add a perf probe to the canary: `ci/canary/probes/proxy_latency_check.sh` — will run at 30s cadence.

alex: Nice. Health gates for canary:
- error rate <= 0.2% over 5m
- 99p latency no more than +15% vs baseline
- KV cache hit rate not decreased by >3%
If any gate fails revert to 0% immediately.

release-czar: Adding note to the weekly changelog under "infra" and sending a Slack-wide freeze reminder at T-3h. :loudspeaker:

lia: For Dedicated customers: no changes to eviction or scheduling. If a Dedicated team opts into patch, they must sign off before 09:00 UTC.

fern: Rollback plan (fast):
1) `ci/canary/set_percent 0`
2) `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-proxy -n infra`
3) restore previous autoscaler: `rctl apply --file=autoscaler-prev.yaml`
Ill keep the runbook link here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-proxy-hotpatch

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary queued: job id dpl-20260325-0712.

alex: If anyone sees config drift or strange scheduling during the window ping me and @release-czar. Ill post live updates in this thread during the canary. Thanks team! :rocket:
